slides.headline: MOST CREATORS STILL PAY FOR EDITING AND CAPTIONS. COPY THESE 10 GEMINI PROMPTS AND GET BOTH FREE.
slides.image_prompt: Sundar Pichai waist-up in bright neon editing suite, grinning with delight, clapping clapperboard; Gemini G glows on clean wall; vivid blue-amber and brilliant white monitor light floods minimal space. 35mm documentary photo.

slides.headline: 1) GENERATE YOUR B-ROLL FOR FREE
slides.body:
Stock footage sites charge up to $500 per clip. Google AI Studio generates custom B-roll from one sentence for free.

"Generate a 5-second video of [your exact scene description]. Style: cinematic, 4K. No people."

slides.headline: 2) WRITE THE HOOK THAT STOPS THE SCROLL
slides.body:
The first 3 seconds of a video decide everything. This prompt delivers five hooks in 30 seconds.

"My video is about: [topic]. Write 5 different 7-second opening hooks. Start mid-action."

slides.headline: 3) CUT ONE VIDEO INTO THREE REELS
slides.body:
A video editor charges $400 to pull the best clips. This prompt picks them from your transcript.

"[Paste transcript]. Find the 3 strongest 60-second moments for Reels. Rank best to worst."

slides.headline: 4) CAPTION EVERY PLATFORM AT ONCE
slides.body:
Writing captions for four platforms used to take 45 minutes. This prompt covers all four at once.

"[Paste transcript]. Write one caption per platform: Instagram 150 chars, YouTube keyword-rich, TikTok 10 words, LinkedIn professional."

slides.headline: 5) FIND WHAT YOUR AUDIENCE ACTUALLY WANTS
slides.body:
Most creators guess what their audience wants. Gemini finds the real pattern in your comments.

"[50 comments]. Tell me the biggest frustration, the repeated question, and 3 video ideas. Use their exact words."

slides.headline: 6) WRITE 10 TITLES IN 30 SECONDS
slides.body:
A YouTube title decides 100 views or 100,000. Gemini writes 10 options and ranks them for you.

"My video: [topic]. Write 10 YouTube titles, flag top 3. Then 5 Reel titles under 8 words."

slides.headline: 7) BUILD A 30-DAY CONTENT CALENDAR
slides.body:
Social media managers charge $2,500 a month to build content calendars. This prompt builds 30 days in 5 minutes.

"I create [type] for [audience] on [platforms]. Build a 30-day calendar: topic, hook, best time."

slides.headline: SAVE THIS: ALL 10 GEMINI VIDEO PROMPTS
slides.body:

Write 5 hooks in 30 seconds
Cut long videos into Reels
Caption every platform at once
Find what your audience wants
Write 10 titles instantly

Daily AI news + skills

caption:
Swipe for all 10 prompts. 🎬 Gemini now writes scripts, generates B-roll, and plans your whole month of content for free.

Inside:
1) Generate custom B-roll free,
2) Write the scroll-stopping hook,
3) Cut one video into three Reels,
4) Caption every platform at once,
5) Find what your audience actually wants,
6) Write 10 titles in 30 seconds,
7) Build your 30-day content calendar,
8) Write your video outro,
9) Repurpose one video ten ways,
10) Turn comments into new video ideas.

CapCut still makes you do all the creative work yourself. Gemini handles the scripting, titles, captions, B-roll, and calendar for free. Creators who figured this out are posting three times the content in half the time.
